title: Edition 3 pilot: concept-first template, chapter 4 Rollup and the Study 04 profile
acceptance_criteria: Macros concept-opener, fit-table, cost-table, case-box, remember, checklist-table and a part opener exist in book/lib/config.typ and panic on invalid input
claim-badge(id) renders one line (id, plain strength, gap kind, link and page of the full card) and resolves through claim-by-id; full cards appear in the evidence index with labels
book/evidence/check.sh recognises claim-badge ids, proven by a bogus id that fails the check
book/front/how-to-use.typ is one page and carries the badge legend, the chapter anatomy, the studies at a glance and the registry-generated gap-kind legend
book/concepts/rollup.typ follows the STYLE.md template, is 2-4 pages and cites v2-02, v2-13, v2-18 and v2-gap-03 by badge; CHECKLIST.md has its row
book/cases/04-configuration-portal.typ follows the profile template and is about one page
New files: no paragraph over 60 words or 3 sentences; numbers only in case boxes and the profile; every number appears in a claim the box cites, listed in RESULT.md
main.typ follows the Edition 3 part order with the Edition 2 material after a labelled divider; every renderable claim is still cited
book/build.sh --out dist/edition3-pilot.pdf verifies; RESULT.md gives the new pages' page numbers and the total page count
Integration only after HIGH review and the owner's approval of the preview; merged into local main and tagged
expected_artifacts: untracked preview PDF for the owner
RESULT.md with the number trace and page numbers
review_policy: HIGH reviews the Decision Log and the preview, then the owner approves the style before integration
